en: Added a warning on Pro and Max plans when resuming an inactive conversation would use a noticeable share of your 5-hour usage limit: resume anyway, or start a new conversation and Claude can look up the previous one if you refer to it
zh: 在 Pro 和 Max 套餐中新增警告：恢复不活跃的对话会占用你 5 小时用量限制中相当可观的一部分时提示：仍要恢复，或开始新对话，若你提及之前的对话，Claude 可以查找它
